glslangValidator runtime tools
================================

The platform glslangValidator binaries in tools/ are preserved from the
original VkLive project so Rezonality retains its established live GLSL to
SPIR-V compiler behavior. They originate from KhronosGroup/glslang and are
distributed under its BSD-3-Clause license:

https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang/blob/main/LICENSE.txt
